payload.text: devbin 0.1.20, hv 2026-11-04: the formula line-length fix (finish_ruby's one-line manifest header, 131 columns for cldr against brew style's 118) plus everything on Devbin's main since v0.1.19, 0320 included (directive 13's batch); the 19 open issues ride later releases. devbin-dc builds under pplr-vc (hv: 'ping pplr-vc for instructions'): issue, fix, a red-then-green test with no magic number, brew style and audit --strict on pplr's, cldr's and ccusage's renders (a trusted scratch tap is hv's call), critic, gates in slots from vc. devbin-vc validates under devbin's rules. hv cuts once GitHub's incident clears. Then devbin-vc's fleet sweep vendors 0.1.20 into pplr, cldr and ccusage (after Molt 1.4.2's cut), hv republishes the three taps' formulae, and homebrew-cldr's and homebrew-ccusage's CI exceptions go (Ccusage's hold 3).
